learning: fixed E022 E009 and fixed E019 oral; separate anchors, not a learning ablation
rule: Sparse mutual-reachability forest, bp-weighted support condensation and marker-weighted antichain; density-only alternative retained

primary.keep: At least +0.005 absolute full-reference weighted R95 in one community; neither community R95 decreases; neither >=90% target count decreases
primary.abandon: Neither community improves weighted R95 or its >=90% target count
primary.modify: All other valid mixed results; failed primary criteria unchanged

references.oral: provided-origin oracle, not unique sequence; known-shared sensitivity unchanged

secondary.completeness: Dominant-origin duplicate-safe source union / full provided reference length
secondary.contamination: Confirmed foreign-origin bp and unresolved bp separately; 1-confirmed all-bin purity is an upper bound
secondary.other: high impurity or unresolved; non-target bins reported separately

extra_scope: No community grouping/score, new fit, baseline rescore, extraction, markers, DNA acquisition or cloud compute in local preparation; new execution approval required
context_semantics: Depth scales from observed eligible measured-parent means only; missing rows omitted from scale estimates and pair evidence. Composition reliability is physical contig length L/(L+2500), an explicit heuristic, not measured coverage variance or independent fourmer confidence.
